service.unit:
# /etc/systemd/system/clear-pex-acs.service
[Unit]
Description=Clear PEX88096 GPU-path ACS dynamically for P2P routing
# Must run after the switch is enumerated (pcieport present) and before any VM
# binds vfio-pci to devices behind the switch. The kernel pcie_acs_override only
# affects IOMMU grouping; the SILICON clear is required for P2P routing, and any
# PCIe reset or reboot re-asserts it. <source-host> renumbers this PCI tree across boots,
# so this must discover GPU paths through the switch instead of using fixed bus
# addresses or endpoint GPU IDs.
After=systemd-modules-load.service
Before=libvirt-guests.service pve-guests.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/clear-pex-acs.sh
RemainAfterExit=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

target: GPU3 <pci> path, hops <pci> + <pci> (unique to GPU3; <pci> excluded as shared with GPU2)
verdict: ACS asserted on the GPU3 deep hops: every pair that completed (8/12) was UNCHANGED (max <3%); no bandwidth collapse.
